verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Lowenstein Sandler as a national U.S. law firm whose seven offices are all in U.S. cities, with no stated offices or qualified practices in other countries. Managing 'global trademark portfolios' is an adjacent service, not multi-country offices or locally qualified practices, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm
